q: it’s starting to hit me that my baby will have to come out one way or another in a few weeks and I’m starting the freak out.
cx: Entering month six of a first pregnancy, the birth suddenly feels real.

q: I’ve been reading about natural births and c-sections and the more I research both the more I’m actually confused about what option I’d feel would be best..
cx: Researching both birth routes leaves her more confused.

q: they’ve all told me that they’d rather have a c-section any day over natural birth as it lasted too long and was painful. My cousin who’s had 3 natural births keeps telling me to go for the natural option
cx: Friends and a cousin give opposite verdicts on how to give birth.

q: the closer I get to parenthood, the more scared I become. I hear friends talk about how hard it is. How exhausted they are. How much their relationships changed. How they lost parts of themselves.
cx: Before trying, friends' stories turn a lifelong wish into doubt.

q: confused as to why Everytime I go to MFM suddenly I’m having issues where my OB is ordering the same tests and they either don’t see an issue or they aren’t telling me there is one.
cx: Two sets of providers give her different pictures of the same pregnancy.

q: Getting out of bed in the morning, getting ready to leave the house, walking around, even simple tasks feel like a huge effort. I also have this constant mild nausea and just an overall feeling of discomfort. I don’t really feel like myself anymore.
cx: Three to four weeks from birth, everything feels heavy.

q: Was being a few days postpartum easier than those final weeks of pregnancy? Did you feel lighter and more comfortable once the baby was out, or was recovery even harder?
cx: Asks whether the days after birth feel better than the last weeks.

q: My care providers are still encouraging me to aim for a natural vaginal birth, but honestly I’m really scared about it.
cx: A short woman told to aim for vaginal birth with a baby estimated large.

q: Has anyone else been in a similar situation small stature with a large baby estimate? How did your birth go? Did you feel supported in your choices, or did you feel pressured one way or another?
cx: Asks for a story from someone in the same position.

q: When I shared that, I felt a bit judged and was told I can’t compare previous pain experiences to labour.
cx: In her NCT WhatsApp group, after saying she wants a medicated birth.

q: Just thinking maybe this NCT group is not for me and I should look elsewhere (I only have 4 weeks left to get my money back and find something else).
cx: Weighing leaving a paid NCT course over the group's attitude.

q: I think that’s the plan to just drop it and get my money back. I think there’s a lot of resources online and I also am going to go to hospital prep classes so not like I will miss out on a lot
cx: Decides to quit NCT; online resources and hospital classes will do.

q: My main reason for joining NCT group/classes was for support and to be able to discuss such things but I might of been wrong 😅
cx: She paid NCT for the peer group, not the teaching.

q: I’ve been listening to some podcasts about hypnobirthing purely for the anxiety part of birth experience and so I know how to navigate myself.
cx: Uses free hypnobirthing podcasts for nerves while planning a medicated birth.

q: Best is that the comment was made by another FTM, so her birth experience is the same as mine - none 🤣 Just bizarre behaviour 🙃
cx: The judgement came from another first-time mother.

q: they told me “don’t stress because you’re harming the babies.” But anxiety is not a switch that you can simply turn off. Hearing this made me feel guilty
cx: Twin pregnancy on bed rest; what her doctor and midwife said.

q: “This is why we don’t want twins, because they come with these kinds of problems.”
cx: What her midwife said during a complication.

q: If I get the urge to pee and I don’t immediately go, I start leaking whether I’m sitting, standing, or laying down sometimes.
cx: At 20 weeks, leaking began at work after trying to finish a task.

q: now I’m scared I’m gonna pee myself on the way or getting down from the car for my anatomy scan and overall I’m just very uncomfortable because peeing myself isn’t fun.
cx: Dreads leaking on the way to her scan.
